name: Generic ABS-R @MakerBot Replicator Z18
filament_notes:
['Derived profile, not a manufacturer specification. ultimaker_absr_175 lists machine blocks for the Method X and the Method XL only; MakerBot never qualified ABS-R for the Z18. Nozzle and bed temperature come from that material data (260 / 95). The material also asks for a 107 C build volume. The Z18 does heat its chamber - firmware 2.6.3.736-6 reports has_heated_chamber true and carries a dedicated chamber toolhead, and it is the only Birdwing machine that does - but it does not reach 107 C. The profile uses 65 C, the same as Generic ABS on this machine. Expect more warping on large parts than a Method X would show, though far less than an unheated enclosure. Fan, flow limit and retraction follow Generic ABS @MakerBot Replicator Z18, because those are set by the machine and the mk13 extruder, not by the material.']

Kammer 60 statt der 65, die dieses Geraet gerade noch erreicht: ein Druck mit 65 brach am 31.08.2026 beim Aufheizen ab, derselbe Drucker laeuft mit 60 durch. Die Firmware gibt fuer die Kammer keinen Vorgabewert ausser 0 (printer_settings.json, toolheads.chamber.heater), die 65 waren eine eigene Ableitung ohne Quelle. Wer die Bedingungen hat, kann hoeher gehen.
